name: svlt
description: Use a local macOS vault for encrypted agent secrets without returning plaintext to Codex, Claude, Hermes, or other MCP agents.

interface.shortDescription: Use encrypted secret references without exposing plaintext.
interface.longDescription: SVLT connects MCP-capable agents to a local macOS app over authenticated IPC. Agents can inspect secret:// references, request local reveal, export app-resolved text to local files, and perform restricted local SSH, HTTP/API, database, SFTP/SCP, browser-login, and app-form actions without returning plaintext.
defaultPrompt: Use a local device credential without revealing plaintext.
